implementation.input: Exactly8 enumerable DATA fields: subjectInputVersion:1, phase:UNSIGNED, paymentRequired, accepted, payerAddress, compiledSporkIds, accountFrontier and momentumAcknowledged. Exact frontier DATA contains address, chainIdentifier, hash and height.
implementation.projection: Return only the existing exact13-field subject. Derive height=frontier.height+1 and previousHash from the same address/chain-bound frontier; recipient, amount, asset and base64 intent data come from the exact selected challenge. Version1/UserSend2/fromBlockHash0 are fixed by the existing contract.
implementation.emptyFrontier: Never infer null, missing or unavailable state as empty. An explicit height0/zeroHash tuple can describe empty-account DATA; it is not proof of actual empty/current account state, funding or permission.
implementation.independentCheck: The producer is synchronous and descriptor-closed. It derives the intent from detached bounded challenge DATA and a safe requirement snapshot, then the existing complete policy binder independently rechecks the produced subject against the original selected inputs. No input callback or await occurs.
implementation.noAuthority: The returned subject is frozen detached DATA, not a preparation receipt, approval, key/signature result or signing capability. UNSIGNED is caller-declared metadata.
implementation.noRewrite: No prior block/payment, subject/recipient/amount/nonce override, consumed authority, retry, approval or replacement argument is accepted. No quote is refreshed.

normativeSource.contract: UserSend previous() checks the prior identifier; AccountBlock.Previous() uses previousHash and height-1 for the non-batched user-account contract. A start block has height1 and zero previousHash.

implementation.noActivation: The planner stub and all prior implementation bytes remain unchanged outside this added function/constants. No active buyer, locked legacy signed composite, SDK, signer, owner/controller, network, schema or operational entrypoint is changed.
